system.description: You have some shelter from the Tremere hunt, whether from an individual bound to you by a vow of friendship or an organization that finds you useful. Work out the specifics with your Storyteller, who plays the character with an interest in keeping you around; protection is not unconditional and can lapse if abused. At 2 points, your shelter is a mortal or ghoul who watches for the torches. At 3 points, a weak vampire companion with a useful Discipline shelters you. At 4 points, you have the security of a church or monastery (without Faith), a coterie of vampires, or an ancilla and several Disciplines. At 5 points, a powerful elder, a church or monastery with Faith, or a mortal lord and retinue shelters you.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
